edges.reason: msg.sender is checked against owner() and used as the mint recipient.
onlyOwner modifier validates msg.sender and msg.sender receives the withdrawn balance.
msg.sender is embedded in the randomness hash, making it caller dependent.
block.timestamp is passed into randomNum to select the gift winner.
block.timestamp is a seed of the pseudo-random generator.
headStart is initialized from block.timestamp.
Withdraw gate compares block.timestamp to headStart.
Constructor parameter flows into setBaseURI.
Owner address parameter enumerates owned tokens.
Modulus parameter bounds the random result.
Seed parameter feeds the randomness hash.
Salt parameter feeds the randomness hash.
Token id parameter is converted and appended to the URI.
New base URI parameter is stored.
New extension parameter is stored.
Local supply value gates the mint and derives the token id.
Locally selected recipient address is the target of the ETH gift call.
Locally computed gift amount is the value forwarded in the external call.
Success flag of the gift call is required by mintFLEX.
Success flag of the withdraw transfer is required.
Computed random number is returned by randomNum.
Balance count sizes the returned token id array.
Token id array is the return value of walletOfOwner.
cost state variable is compared against msg.value.
maxSupply state variable gates minting and grand prize condition.
maxSupply is compared with supply to allow withdrawal.
headStart timestamp gate controls withdrawal.
baseURI state variable is returned by _baseURI.
_baseURI result is concatenated in tokenURI.
randomNum output selects the gift recipient inside mintFLEX.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
setBaseExtension writes the baseExtension state variable.
mintFLEX calls _safeMint which may re-enter via receiver callback before all transfers complete.
mintFLEX performs an external ETH call to the selected gift owner after minting.
mintFLEX performs an external ETH call to the fixed commission address.
withdraw sends the full balance via low-level call to msg.sender.
Constructor invokes setBaseURI.
Constructor self-mints token 1 through _safeMint.
randomNum relies on predictable block.timestamp derived randomness.
_safeMint triggers onERC721Received on recipient contracts, enabling reentrancy.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _initBaseURI is only used to initialize contract state in the constructor.
walletOfOwner parameter feeds the enumeration view function.
randomNum modulus parameter belongs to the randomNum function.
randomNum seed parameter belongs to the randomNum function.
randomNum salt parameter belongs to the randomNum function.
tokenId parameter is only consumed by tokenURI.
setBaseURI parameter is stored by the owner-only setter.
setBaseExtension parameter is stored by the owner-only setter.
Local supply value is derived and consumed inside mintFLEX.
Local giftAddress is the destination of the external gift call.
Local giftValue is the amount forwarded in the external gift call.
Local success flag is checked by mintFLEX after the gift call.
Local bool s captures the result of the external withdraw call.
Local num is the pseudo-random value returned by randomNum.
Local ownerTokenCount sizes the array in walletOfOwner.
Local tokenIds array is the walletOfOwner return value.
